tex_content.html:
Proposition
[Symmetric-coefficient Harnack constant] 1. ch8:8.3\group ch08-generalized-solutions If $[a^{ij}]$ is symmetric, the constant in Theorem 8.20 may be chosen so that \[ C\leq C_0^{\sqrt{\Lambda /\lambda +\nu R}}, \qquad C_0=C_0(n). \]
